name: slice_zero_comp
summary: Compare integrated zero terms; the zero term of a composite splitting is the composite of the zero terms.

steps.claim: Two real data are equal when their integrated zero terms agree (`eq_of_integrated_zeroTerm_eq`); the zero term for A∘B is the zero term for B of the zero term for A (`Space.Splitting.zeroTerm_homSource_comp`, twice), and the slice at 0 is the zero term of the integrated datum (`zeroTerm_integrated`, with the vacuum slice).
steps.lean:
(realSlice A U 0 y) := eq_of_integrated_zeroTerm_eq (isAdapted_homSource ..) fun _ ↦
  (zeroTerm_integrated ..).symm.trans (by rw [zeroTerm_homSource_comp, zeroTerm_homSource_comp,
  zeroTerm_integrated, zeroTerm_integrated,
  ← (by simpa [slice_vac] using zeroTerm_integrated (isAdapted_homSource A U) vacVector :)]; rfl)
